# Automatic Test Repository Cleanup

This module provides a session-scoped autouse pytest fixture that automatically deletes all test repositories in the database whose slugs match specific prefixes used by integration tests. This prevents accumulation of throwaway repositories and their associated data after test runs, ensuring the database remains clean across multiple test sessions.
